title: Which Provider Can Handle Insurance Premium Payments and Claim Disbursements?
summary: Learn how Usio simplifies insurance premium payments and claim disbursements with one connected payment platform.
body_markdown:
**One Company. Payments In. Payments Out. Less Work for Everyone.**


If you oversee the claims process, you already manage enough moving parts. Policyholders, adjusters, repair facilities, healthcare providers, finance teams and executives all need something from you, usually at the same time.


The last thing you need is a payment system that adds more vendors, contracts, integrations, reports and support numbers to your day.


Using one company for both insurance premium payments and claim disbursements can reduce costs, save time, simplify reconciliation and give your team a clearer view of money moving in and out. Instead of managing a patchwork of payment providers, your organization gets one connected solution.


That company is Usio.


## Premium Payments Should Be the Easy Part


Policyholders expect paying a premium to be simple, convenient and secure. They want payment choices, and your team wants those choices to work together without creating additional administrative headaches.


Usio supports a wide range of payment acceptance options, including:


- Credit cards


- Debit cards


- ACH payments


- Same-day and next-day ACH


- PINless debit


- Remotely created checks


- [Hosted payment pages](https://usio.com/hosted-payment-pages-a-smarter-way-to-accept-payments/)
- Mobile and online payments


- Text-to-pay


- Electronic billing and payment


Whether a policyholder wants to make a one-time payment, enroll in recurring payments or pay through a digital channel, Usio helps create a more convenient experience.


Because “please call another provider” is not exactly the customer journey anyone is trying to build.


## Claim Payments Are Where the Promise Becomes Real


Collecting premiums keeps policies active. Paying claims is where an insurance company delivers on its promise.


A claimant may be recovering from an accident, repairing a home, replacing damaged property or dealing with an unexpected medical expense. Once a claim is approved, that person does not want to hear about batch schedules, vendor limitations or banking delays.


They want their money.


You already understand the importance of that moment. You oversee one of the most demanding and visible parts of the insurance experience. You deserve a payment platform that makes your job easier while giving claimants more control over how they receive their funds.


Usio provides multiple disbursement options through one platform, allowing insurers to select the right payment rail for each claim and recipient.


## Every Major Way to Send Claim Funds


**Real-Time Payments**


Real-Time Payments can send funds directly to an eligible bank account within seconds. They are ideal for urgent claims, emergency assistance and situations where waiting several business days is simply not good enough.


**Push-to-Debit**


Push-to-debit sends funds directly to an eligible recipient’s existing debit card. It provides fast access to money without requiring the claimant to open a new account or wait for a card to arrive.


**Same-Day and Next-Day ACH**


ACH offers a reliable and cost-effective way to deposit claim funds directly into a recipient’s bank account. It is well suited for high-volume claims, settlements, reimbursements, premium refunds and other routine disbursements.


**Virtual Cards**


Virtual cards provide a secure digital payment option for claimants, repair facilities, healthcare providers, contractors and other approved recipients. Funds can be delivered without printing or mailing a physical card.


**Physical and Virtual Prepaid Cards**


Usio can issue brandable physical and virtual prepaid cards. These cards can give recipients convenient access to funds while supporting controls over how program money is used when needed.


[Prepaid cards](https://usio.com/the-power-of-prepaid-a-smarter-way-to-disburse-funds/) can also help insurers serve claimants who do not have easy access to a traditional bank account.


**PayPal and Venmo**


For recipients who prefer familiar digital wallets, funds can be delivered through PayPal or Venmo. This gives claimants another convenient way to receive and access their money.


**Paper Checks**


Yes, some people still want a check. And that is perfectly fine.


Usio provides check printing and mailing, allowing insurers to maintain an important traditional payment option without managing a separate check-production provider.


Modernizing claims should not mean forcing every claimant to modernize on your schedule.


**Send-2-ATM**


Send-2-ATM gives eligible recipients another way to access funds through secure ATM withdrawals. It can be especially useful when a recipient needs cash access but does not want to wait for a mailed payment.


**Payment Choice Is a Better Claims Experience**


The smartest claims leaders know that speed and convenience mean different things to different people.


One claimant may want an immediate deposit to a debit card. Another may prefer ACH. Someone without a traditional bank account may need a prepaid card. A repair facility may prefer a virtual card. And someone will always ask, “Can you just mail me a check?”


The best strategy is not forcing everyone onto one payment rail.


It is choosing one provider that can support the right rail for every payment.


## Why One Provider Makes Your Claims Operation Stronger


Bringing premium acceptance and claim disbursements together can help your organization achieve:


- Fewer vendor relationships


- Lower administrative and integration costs


- Faster and easier reconciliation


- Greater visibility into incoming and outgoing payments


- More choices for policyholders and claimants


- Faster delivery of approved claim funds


- Less dependence on manual check processes


- A more consistent experience across the policy lifecycle


- One accountable payment partner


And let’s be honest: one accountable partner is far better than a conference call where four vendors politely explain why the problem belongs to one of the other three.


## Which Provider Can Do Both?


Usio.


Usio helps insurance organizations accept premium payments through cards, ACH, PINless debit, remotely created checks and digital payment experiences.


When it is time to send money, Usio supports


[Real-Time Payments](https://usio.com/why-real-time-disbursements-are-now-a-business-essential/) , push-to-debit, same-day and next-day


[ACH](https://usio.com/ach-payments/) , virtual cards, physical and virtual prepaid cards, PayPal, Venmo, paper checks and Send-2-ATM.


That means your organization can collect premiums, issue refunds, return overpayments, pay approved claims and compensate vendors without assembling a small army of disconnected payment providers.


You already have enough complexity to manage. Your payment infrastructure should remove obstacles, not introduce new ones.


**One company. Payments in. Payments out. Every major way money needs to move.**


**That is the Usio advantage.**
